name: Kavita
description: Read comics, manga and ebooks in your browser.
compose:
services:
  kavita:
    image: jvmilazz0/kavita:latest
    container_name: kavita
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:5000"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/kavita/config
      - /srv/books:/books
